write_up: Your resume points to Staff Accountant and Accounts Payable Specialist roles. A recruiter can see both the invoice work you do now at Bayou Industrial Supply and the broader accounting work you did at Minh Phat Trading Company. That combination makes your experience easy to place.

The strongest line is the one about reducing month-end closing from 12 days to 7 days. It names the change and the checklist and template you made to get there. Your Experience section leads Education, and your current role is dated clearly.

Start with the month-end closing line at Bayou: tell us which tasks you helped the controller complete. Then add what you contributed to the audit at Minh Phat. A final grammar pass will polish the resume without changing the work you describe.
